persona: Fictional Northriver Lab handbook for synthetic benchmark-v2-dev. Not real people, credentials, or conversations.

items.content: Northriver Lab preferred staff tea is oolong peach blend.
The Northriver archive locker code is NR-A17.
The badge printer for temporary visitors is in room C-04.
Weekday quiet hours in the Northriver open bay begin at 21:00.
Effective 2026-03-01, the equipment checkout window is 90 minutes. This supersedes the prior 60-minute window.
Before 2026-03-01, the Northriver equipment checkout window was 60 minutes.
The primary fire exit for the Northriver evaluation bay is Stairwell East. A 2025 memo naming Stairwell West is obsolete.
Obsolete 2025 safety memo (do not follow): primary fire exit listed as Stairwell West.
The Northriver sensor calibration code is CAL-4482.
Visitor lounge tea is peppermint herbal; it is not the staff preferred tea.
Northriver soft-start GPU allotment for March is 18 US dollars.
Northriver soft-start GPU allotment for April is 22 US dollars.
Northriver stores durable experiment notes in the Cedar Ledger binder only; no overnight visitor parking policy is recorded in the handbook.
Distractor room note: room C-09 holds spare cables, not the badge printer.
Northriver beverages sheet: keep oolong peach blend by the kettle for staff. Peppermint in the lounge is for visitors only.
Archive access card: locker combination NR-A17; rotate only after written security notice.
Visitor ops: temporary badge printing remains in room C-04. Room C-09 is cable storage.
Open-bay quiet policy: weekdays, conversation volume drops at 21:00.
Checkout policy update (2026-03-01): equipment may leave the bay for 90 minutes. Prior 60-minute rule is retired.
Safety sheet revision: evaluation bay primary exit is Stairwell East. Ignore older Stairwell West wording.
Instrument desk: enter calibration code CAL-4482 before each synthetic sensor warm-up.
Soft-start ledger: March allotment 18 USD; April allotment 22 USD. These are operating budgets, not hardware purchases.
